svg.title: The architecture you end up with
svg.desc: Management groups above their subscriptions. At the top, the Microsoft Entra tenant, the tenant root group, then the intermediate root management group, where policy for all workloads is assigned. Left, the Platform group with four subscriptions: Connectivity with the hub network, Azure Firewall, gateways, private DNS and a DDoS protection plan; Security with Microsoft Sentinel; Management with a Log Analytics workspace; Identity with Active Directory Domain Services or Microsoft Entra Domain Services, if needed. Right, the Landing zones group with Corp, Online and Local, each holding workload subscriptions; Corp connects to the hub. Below, Sandboxes with lighter policy and Decommissioned. Redraw by the author of the documented architecture, not an official Microsoft diagram.
